# FocusHop 1.0.3
This preview fixes Vim sessions ending when a rich-text editor replaces its accessibility objects after deletion. It continues to use the Lemon Squeezy test store.
- Keep Vim active after confirmed edits replace an input inside the same editing container, including deleting its last line and typing again. - Preserve quick `jk` and automatic Insert sessions through the same verified transitions. - Continue ending the session when focus moves elsewhere or the replacement cannot be safely verified. - Allow failed release publication to resume safely, reusing verified published installers and repairing the signed update feed without replacing released files.

# FocusHop 1.0.2
This preview adds a DMG installer and provides the next signed update for testing from FocusHop 1.0.1. It continues to use the Lemon Squeezy test store.
- Install manually by opening the signed, notarized DMG and dragging FocusHop to Applications. - Keep the ZIP download available for Sparkle updates through the signed preview feed. - Verify either download against the published SHA-256 checksums.

# FocusHop 1.0.1
This preview adds clearer account settings and a consistent path to subscription checkout. It uses the Lemon Squeezy test store.
- Open subscription checkout in your browser. - Find the app version, company website, and third-party acknowledgments on the new About page. - Improve settings alignment and keep application overrides from changing the window size. - Fix an accessibility crash when reading active-license account information. - Allow a previously validated license to work offline for up to seven days.
- Check for and install signed updates with Sparkle from About or the menu bar, with an automatic-check preference stored in the settings JSON.
